goal: bun run e2e builds an npm pack tarball install root, serves a scripted mock model from cassettes, launches the pinned real claude binary against it through an extended fake-herdr that spawns Host processes, and completes a smoke journey; e2e files are black-box (no runtime imports) and excluded from bun test; the Pi mock-model feasibility result is recorded in the Spec (Spec D2-D5) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S2; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

A file under tests/e2e/ that imports a plugins/immune-brain/runtime module fails the boundary test naming the file and the import specifier, and bun test collects no file under tests/e2e/. Done looks like: tests/e2e-black-box-boundary.test.ts asserts both against fixtures.
